d:
Official music video for It's A Sin by Pet Shop Boys. Taken from the album, Actually. Video directed by Derek Jarman, the first of several collaborations between the band and director. Song released in 1987 and produced by Julian Mendelsohn and Stephen Hague.
Lyrics:
When I look back upon my life
it’s always with a sense of shame
I’ve always been the one to blame
For everything I long to do
no matter when or where or who
has one thing in common too
